message.content: The agent inspected /app/weights.pt and /app/dataset.pt, reconstructed a RecoveredModel (Linear 64→128 "embedding", sinusoidal pos_encoder.pe, 3-layer encoder, 1-layer decoder, Linear 128→64 output_layer), tuned only output_layer via closed-form least squares for both call patterns, saved TorchScript to /app/model.pt, and verified all criteria pass (MSE 1.551→0.162 and 1.543→0.809).
